title: Market Analyst
shortSummary: Harvest Table Group is hiring a Market Analyst to turn sales, pricing and competitor data into clear recommendations for its restaurant network.
overview: Harvest Table Group runs more than 80 restaurants across the Midwest and is looking for a curious Market Analyst.
You will join six analysts and work with strategy and menu teams on pricing studies and market reports.
responsibilities: <ul>
• Collect and clean sales, pricing and competitor data from many sources.
• Build dashboards and monthly reports that track category and menu trends.
• Analyze guest surveys and segment customers by visit behavior and value.
• Present findings to leadership and help shape pricing and location decisions.
• Keep research notes and data sources organized and current.
requiredQualifications: <ul>
• 1-3 years in market research or business analysis
• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables
• Working knowledge of SQL and Looker or Power BI
• Confidence explaining numbers in simple language
• Degree in economics, statistics or business
niceToHave: • Experience with Python or R for analysis

title: Medical Assistant

• 1-3 years of experience as a medical assistant

title: Ethical Hacker

responsibilities: <ul>

• Find, verify and rank security weaknesses by their real business risk.
• Write clear reports with practical, step-by-step fixes.
• Retest every fix and confirm each issue is fully resolved and closed.
• Share security tips with client teams in short, practical workshops.
requiredQualifications: <ul>
• 2-4 years of penetration testing experience
• Good knowledge of the OWASP Top 10
• Hands-on experience with Burp Suite and Nmap
• Basic scripting skills in Python or Bash
• Clear writing for technical and non-technical readers
